_comment: agent 站 pitfalls 英文 · 第 2 批（MCP 分区的补充条目）。与 _pitfalls-a.en.json 合并使用。
_principles: 同第1 批：判断强度与未核验标记必须保留；参数原样。
git: Assuming it is read-only — it can commit and switch branches
Assuming a container deployment can reach the host repo without help — without a mount it cannot read it
Assuming it can push or open PRs — this server only does local operations
memory: Assuming memories live only in the current session — they are disk-persisted global state
Assuming deletion needs approval — it does not, and an accidental delete affects every later session
Assuming it is a plain key-value store — it is a knowledge-graph structure
playwright: Treating `allowed-origins` as an access allowlist — the official docs state it is not a security boundary and does not guard against redirects
Assuming headless mode stays resident — headless closes after 1 hour idle by default, while headed never closes by default
Forcing MCP into high-throughput coding work — the official guidance itself suggests CLI + SKILLS instead
sequential-thinking: Assuming it makes the model smarter — it only constrains the shape of the output; the reasoning comes from the model itself
Assuming it remembers previous thoughts — each call has to carry the full context itself
Assuming more tools are better — this server deliberately ships exactly one
time: Assuming the model already knows the exact time — it needs this to read the system clock rather than guess
Assuming it can schedule tasks — it only reads the time, it does not schedule
github-mcp: Mistaking it for the archived reference server in the MCP org — that one lives in `servers-archived`; this is GitHub's official, actively maintained product line
Treating lockdown mode as a security boundary — the official text says it is best-effort content filtering and does not change what the credentials can read or write
Assuming read-only is merely a default — it is enforced filtering: write tools stay disabled even when explicitly requested with `--tools`
